title: Microsoft Teams chats and files
whyItMatters: Teams keeps cached chats, channel posts, meeting details and downloaded files. It shows the employer, colleagues and projects the person worked with.
source: Microsoft Learn, Clear the Teams client cache (new Teams path under Packages/MSTeams_LocalCache): https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/troubleshoot/microsoftteams/teams-administration/clear-teams-cache
notes: New Teams (MSIX). Classic Teams kept data in the roaming folder under Microsoft Teams. Signing out of Teams does not remove the cache; the app has to be reset.

cleanup.exportFirst: Download any file or chat you need from Teams first, because only the local cache is removed here.
cleanup.signOut: In Teams, open your profile picture and sign out, so the account no longer keeps a session on this PC.
steps: Uninstall Microsoft Teams from Settings > Apps > Installed apps.
Delete the Teams cache folder named in the plan if it is still there.
cleanup.risk: Removes cached chats, channel posts and downloaded files for every account used in Teams on this PC.
cleanup.source: Microsoft Learn, Clear the Teams client cache: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/troubleshoot/microsoftteams/teams-administration/clear-teams-cache
